tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background, a bright sea-salt white.

tokens.name: ground-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, the booking panel, menus and dialogs.

tokens.name: ground-sunk
tokens.usage: Tinted bands (amenities, footer), photo slots, input fills.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and card edges; never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input, select and date-field borders; 3.3:1 or better on ground and ground-raised.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body copy on ground, ground-raised, ground-sunk and jungle-soft.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, room facts, on any ground or jungle-soft.

tokens.name: jungle
tokens.usage: The brand green: logo mark, secondary buttons, links, selected dates, icons; as text on any ground.

tokens.name: jungle-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fills behind jungle or ink: icon discs, amenity tiles, hover rows.

tokens.name: on-jungle
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a jungle fill.

tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: The single accent, a hibiscus coral: the booking CTA, rating stars, the active nav marker. Fill only, never body text (2.1:1 on ground).

tokens.name: on-coral
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a coral fill (the primary CTA label, 7.7:1).

tokens.name: coral-ink
tokens.usage: Coral as text: offers, 'few nights left', on any ground.

tokens.name: coral-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background behind coral-ink text (offer strip).

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Form errors and 'Fully booked'. Always with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The 2px solid focus ring with 2px offset on every interactive element.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind text set on photography.

tokens.name: on-scrim
tokens.usage: Text on the scrim over a photo.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links; an alias of jungle.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.sample: Your garden home for slow, sunny mornings
styles.usage: Hero headline, once per page, max 2 lines. Scales to 40px/44px on phones.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Inner page titles and the closing call to action.

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: Breakfast is on the veranda from 7:30.
styles.usage: Hero subtext and section intros, max 25 words.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Every room opens onto the garden and has its own bathroom.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels; as an uppercase eyebrow at most once per three sections.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Buttons and tabs, one line, 3 words max for primary CTAs.

spacing.note: A 4px base. Sections use space-16 on phones and space-24 on desktop (taste-skill density 3: airy).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Label-to-input gaps, chip padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input padding, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Phone page gutter, card padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding, grid gaps.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Heading to content.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Desktop page gutter, gaps between groups.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop (also the hero top padding cap).

radius.note: Shape rule: everything you press is a pill; everything you look at (cards, photos, tiles) is radius-lg; hero and featured-room photos get the villa arch on their top corners.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Menus, the date picker, small tiles inside cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, photo frames, bento tiles, the booking panel.

tokens.name: radius-arch
tokens.usage: Top two corners only of the hero and featured-room photos: border-radius: var(--radius-arch) var(--radius-arch) var(--radius-lg) var(--radius-lg).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, chips and availability pills.

shadow.note: Shadows are tinted to the garden green, never pure black on Day.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: Cards at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: Hovered cards, the scrolled header.

tokens.name: shadow-3
tokens.usage: The booking panel over the hero, dialogs, the mobile menu.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the page container.

tokens.name: text-measure
tokens.usage: Max width of running text.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Site header height (64px on phones); never above 80px.

breakpoint.note: Mobile first, matching the taste-skill scale. Every multi-column layout collapses to one column below bp-md.

tokens.name: bp-sm
tokens.usage: Booking fields go two-up.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: Two-column layouts start.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: Desktop nav, booking bar in one row.

tokens.name: bp-xl
tokens.usage: Wider gutters.
